title: hytalecraft
description: An advanced Velocity bridge with built-in UDP protocol listener connecting Hytale, Minecraft Java, and Bedrock (Geyser).
body: The Prototype Vision This project serves as the foundation for a universal translator. Java Support: Native Velocity handling on port 25577. Bedrock Support: Seamless integration with Geyser/Floodgate on port 19132. Hytale Bridge: Custom UDP Listener on port 5520 using Netty NIO. Current Capabilities Multi-Port Listening: Successfully manages TCP and UDP traffic at the same time. Identity Sync: Integrated with SkinsRestorer to keep player appearances consistent across protocols. Ping/Pong Logic: Active UDP responder for Hytale-protocol discovery. How to Install the Prototype Proxy: Place CodeNinjaBridge.jar into your Velocity plugins folder. Backend: Connect your Paper server to the Velocity velocity.toml file. Ports: Make sure ports 25577, 19132, and 5520 are open.
